summary: Preinstall drops Bun runtime to execute an obfuscated 727KB payload unrelated to the billing SDK
details: package.json declares scripts.preinstall = 'node setup.mjs'. setup.mjs downloads the Bun runtime from github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases, extracts and chmods the binary, and invokes it via execFileSync against math_init.js — a 727KB Bun-compiled bundle (header '// @bun @bun-cjs') at the package root that is heavily obfuscated with string-array rotator obfuscation, single-letter and _0xXXXX identifiers, a large constant table (n7gIxM), a rotator (WV8StW), and a decoder (hc1jfK9). The bundle has no source-level relation to the package's stated billing SDK API, is not referenced by the README or package.json aside from setup.mjs, and is invoked exclusively through the fetched Bun binary rather than Node — the alternate-runtime-dropper pattern that pins execution to a runtime Node-based scanners cannot introspect. Installing the package runs the obfuscated payload on the installer's host during `npm install`.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
